text.en: Dawn broke. The mining village.
Where sixty remained.
Where Yuna's father's grave was.
Where chalk names were on the walls.

text.ko: 이 마을은 지도에 없었다. MCC 지도에도. 화성 공식 지도에도.
text.en: This village was on no map. Not MCC's. Not the official Mars map.
But it was here.

text.ko: Mikhail이 거기 있었다. 차를 끓이고 있었다.
text.en: Mikhail was there. Making tea.
Right hand supporting the left. As always.

text.ko: 다리가 더 나빠진 것 같았다. 그러나 차는 끓이고 있었다.
text.en: His leg seemed worse. But he was making tea.

text.ko: 이 사람이 차를 끓이는 것을 멈추면 FSP가 무언가를 잃는 것이었다.
text.en: The day this man stopped making tea FSP would lose something.
Today he made tea.
Yuna sat beside Mikhail.

text.ko: 두 손으로 잔을 들고. 그것을 배운 것이었다.
text.en: Holding her cup with both hands. She had learned that.
Twenty-one years old. First generation born on Mars.

text.ko: 그녀의 아버지는 그녀가 여덟 살 때 죽었다.
text.en: Her father died when she was eight.
A mining accident. His name was on the wall.

text.ko: 별표가 달린 이름. 화성 출생 표시.
text.en: A name with a star. The Mars-born marking.
Today is the day.
What FSP wanted for twenty-eight years.

text.ko: 광부들이 자신의 이름으로 화성에서 사는 것.
text.en: For miners to live on Mars in their own names.
That is decided today.
You make the final decision.

text.ko: 나는 차를 마실 거예요. 이미 결정했어요.
text.en: I'll drink my tea. I've already decided.

text.ko: 올림포스 합의 이후 세 가지가 생겼어요.
text.en: After the Olympus agreement three things emerged.

text.ko: 첫째. MCC가 노동자 등록 시스템 구축을 시작했어요.
text.en: First. MCC began building the worker registration system.

text.ko: 둘째. Talon Group 내부 조사가 시작됐어요.
text.en: Second. An internal investigation into Talon Group began.
Third. A traitor within FSP was identified.
Who.
Thomas Alder.
Thomas Alder.

text.ko: 의원회 선거에서 논란이 된 사람. MCC 출신 의혹.
text.en: The controversial one in the assembly election. Suspected MCC background.

text.ko: 그가 Talon Group에 올림포스 회담 위치를 넘겼다.
text.en: He had passed the Olympus summit location to Talon Group.
There was evidence.
The result of Amara chasing it down for days.
With her injured arm.

text.ko: Thomas Alder는 Talon Group 화성 지부 소속이었어요.
text.en: Thomas Alder was a member of Talon Group's Mars branch.
He infiltrated FSP. From the beginning.
Was the assembly election also their plan.
To divide FSP. It worked. Partially.

text.ko: Thomas Alder도 이름이 있어요. 그러나 그 이름은 우리가 어떻게 해야 해요.
text.en: Thomas Alder has a name too. But what do we do with that name.
That is today's question.
Thomas Alder was there. At the edge of the village.
He already knew. That he had been found.
He hadn't run.
He was waiting.
I know. Why you came.

text.ko: Talon Group. Pilgrim Arms. 당신 때문에 사람이 다쳤어요.
text.en: Talon Group. Pilgrim Arms. People were hurt because of you.
I didn't say to kill anyone.
You handed over the location.
... Yes. I did.
Why.

text.ko: 나는 MCC 출신이에요. 진짜로. 아버지가 MCC 엔지니어였어요.
text.en: I'm really from MCC. Genuinely. My father was an MCC engineer.

text.ko: 그래서 Talon이 접근했어요. 이십 년 전.
text.en: So Talon approached me. Twenty years ago.

text.ko: 처음엔 정보만 넘기면 된다고 했어요. 그냥 보고서.
text.en: At first they said just pass information. Just reports.

text.ko: 그런데 이십 년이 됐어요. 그게 내 인생이 됐어요.
text.en: Then twenty years passed. It became my life.

text.ko: FSP에 있는 동안... 나는 FSP가 옳다고 생각했어요. 진짜로.
text.en: While I was in FSP... I actually thought FSP was right. Genuinely.
That statement is true.

text.ko: Rev. Hale이 Thomas Alder 앞으로 걸어갔다.
text.en: Rev. Hale walked toward Thomas Alder.

text.ko: Lena가 막으려 했다. Rev. Hale이 손을 들었다. 기다려요.
text.en: Lena tried to stop him. Rev. Hale raised a hand. Wait.

text.ko: Rev. Hale이 Thomas Alder 옆에 앉았다.
text.en: Rev. Hale sat beside Thomas Alder.
On the ground. On the dirt at the village's edge.
Said nothing.
Just was there.
... What are you doing.

text.ko: 있어요. 이름이 있는 사람 옆에 있어요.
text.en: Being here. Being beside a person who has a name.
I'm a traitor.
Yes. And you are Thomas Alder.

text.ko: 이름을 기록하면 책임도 따라요. 그것을 피할 수 없어요.
text.en: When a name is recorded accountability follows. You cannot avoid that.
The player had to decide.
What to do with Thomas Alder.
Lena was waiting.
Amara was waiting.
The village was waiting.

prompt.ko: Thomas Alder. 배신자이자 사람. 어떻게 해야 합니까.
prompt.en: Thomas Alder. Traitor and person. What must be done.

text.ko: 공개 재판. Talon Group과 함께 이름으로 기록된다.
text.en: Public trial. Recorded by name together with Talon Group.

preview_hint.en: → The principle of names applies to traitors too

text.en: Exile. Send him off Mars.

preview_hint.ko: → 일 처리가 빠르다. 그러나 기록이 없다

text.en: Use him as a witness against Talon Group.

preview_hint.ko: → 더 큰 적을 잡을 수 있다

text.en: Leave it to Rev. Hale.
The Thomas Alder matter was decided.

text.ko: 그러나 더 큰 결정이 남아 있었다.
text.en: But a larger decision remained.
The future of FSP.
After the Olympus agreement Mars had changed.

text.ko: 화성 노동자 등록 시스템이 만들어지고 있었다.
text.en: The Mars Worker Registration System was being built.
FSP had demanded it. For twenty-eight years.
The goal was achieved. Partially.

text.ko: FSP가 다음에 무엇이 될지를 정해야 해요.
text.en: We need to decide what FSP becomes next.

text.ko: 우리가 원한 게 이름이었잖아요. 이름이 기록되는 거.
text.en: What we wanted was names. For names to be recorded.
If that happened... what comes next.
That is always the difficult question.

text.ko: 목표를 이루고 나서. 운동은 어디로 가야 해요.
text.en: After achieving the goal. Where should the movement go.
When names are recorded those names make demands.
Water rights. Medicine. Education. The next generation.
The rights of people born on Mars.
FSP must continue that fight.
Or in a different way.

text.ko: 다른 방식. 그것을 결정해야 해요. 오늘.
text.en: A different way. That must be decided. Today.

text.ko: 벽이 있었다. 분필 이름들이 있는 벽.
text.en: There was a wall. The wall with chalk names.
Kim Yong-jin. Yuna's father.
Names with stars. Mars-born.

text.ko: 그 아래 이름들. 지구에서 온 사람들.
text.en: Names below. People who came from Earth.
All on the same wall.
Rev. Hale looked at that wall.
This wall tells you what FSP is.
Names.
Names. That is FSP.

text.ko: 28년 전 내가 이 운동을 시작할 때 그것을 알았어요.
text.en: When I started this movement twenty-eight years ago I knew that.
Names. That was the one thing.

text.ko: 그러면 다음도 이름들이에요. 아직 기록 안 된 이름들.
text.en: Then what's next is also names. Names not yet recorded.
But there was movement from outside Mars too.
Earth. Talon Group's parent companies.

text.ko: 올림포스 합의가 알려지자 그들이 움직이기 시작했다.
text.en: When the Olympus agreement became known they began to move.

text.ko: 화성 독립 반대 로비. 경제 제재 압박.
text.en: Lobbying against Martian independence. Economic sanction pressure.
The Gaia ship had become the symbol.

text.ko: 함선 하나. 그러나 그것이 화성의 방향을 보여주는 것이었다.
text.en: One ship. But it showed the direction of Mars.

text.ko: 지구 측 연합이 Gaia 출항을 막으려 해요.
text.en: The Earth-side coalition is trying to block Gaia's departure.
How.

text.ko: 화성 경제 봉쇄. MCC에 압박. 합의를 뒤집으라고.
text.en: Mars economic blockade. Pressure on MCC. Demanding they reverse the agreement.

text.ko: 28년 동안 이런 일이 있었어요. 지구가 화성을 누를 때.
text.en: This happened over twenty-eight years. Every time Earth pressed Mars.
We endured. We must endure this time too.
Gaia needs to launch. That is the answer.
New Athens Shipyard.

text.ko: Gaia 함선. 화성 자체 건조. 지구 의존 없이.
text.en: The Gaia ship. Built by Mars itself. Without Earth dependence.

text.ko: Olu Adeyemi가 거기 있었다. 함선 옆에.
text.en: Olu Adeyemi was there. Beside the ship.
Writing a letter to Mariam. As today too.

text.ko: Mariam이 죽은 지 여섯 달이었다. 광산 사고.
text.en: It had been six months since Mariam died. A mining accident.

text.ko: Olu는 매일 편지를 썼다. 함선에 넣었다.
text.en: Olu wrote every day. And put the letters in the ship.
You came.

text.ko: 지구 측이 출항을 막으려 한다는 거 알아요.
text.en: I know the Earth-side is trying to block the launch.
Is there a way.
There is. One.

text.ko: Gaia가 지금 뜨는 거예요. 봉쇄 전에.
text.en: Gaia launches now. Before the blockade.
We're eighty percent ready. It's dangerous. But possible.
Eighty percent. A dangerous figure.

text.ko: 그러나 Olu는 해낼 수 있다고 했다.
text.en: But Olu said he could do it.
A ship built with Mariam's wedding money.

text.ko: Mariam이 말했다. 결혼은 두 번 할 수 있다. 우주선은 한 번 만드는 거라고.
text.en: Mariam had said. Marriage can happen twice. A spaceship is made once.
Those words had come this far.
Did Mariam want this.

text.ko: 처음엔 몰랐어요. 내가 설명했어요. 그다음에 알았어요.
text.en: At first she didn't know. I explained. Then she knew.
And she agreed. That was Mariam.

text.ko: Mariam Adeyemi. 이 함선에 이름이 있어요.
text.en: Mariam Adeyemi. This ship has that name.
There's a reason the ship's name is Gaia.

text.ko: Mariam의 첫 번째 딸이 그 이름이었어요. 사산이었어요. 화성에서.
text.en: Mariam's first daughter had that name. She was stillborn. On Mars.
The space went quiet.
Gaia. A name meaning Earth.

text.ko: 그러나 화성에서 태어났다가 죽은 아이의 이름이기도 했다.
text.en: But also the name of a child born and died on Mars.
Olu had given that name to the ship.
There were names.
There were always names.
The launch decision. You must make it.
Eighty percent. That is my answer. It's possible.
It's dangerous. Olu.

text.ko: 화성에서 위험하지 않은 게 뭐가 있어요. Mikhail.
text.en: What isn't dangerous on Mars. Mikhail.
... Tea isn't dangerous.
That's right. Tea isn't dangerous.
The Earth-side blockade began.

text.ko: 화성 궤도에 두 척의 함선이 나타났다.
text.en: Two ships appeared in Mars orbit.
Earth Coalition ships. Warning transmitted.

text.ko: 화성 독립 관련 활동 즉시 중단 요구.
text.en: Demanding immediate cessation of Mars independence-related activities.
Gaia launch prohibited.

text.ko: 72시간 내 응답 없으면 경제 제재 발동.
text.en: Economic sanctions in 72 hours without response.
Seventy-two hours. MCC is wavering.
Chen Weiss.

text.ko: 지구 측 압박이 강해요. 경제 제재가 현실이면 MCC 경제가 무너져요.
text.en: Earth-side pressure is strong. If sanctions are real MCC's economy collapses.
Same as twenty-eight years ago.

text.ko: 화성이 지구에 독립을 요구할 때마다. 지구가 경제를 들고 왔어요.
text.en: Every time Mars demanded independence from Earth. Earth brought economics.
That's why Gaia is the answer.

text.ko: Gaia가 뜨면 화성이 지구 없이도 이동할 수 있다는 걸 보여주는 거예요.
text.en: If Gaia launches it shows Mars can move without Earth.
That neutralizes the economic blockade. As a symbol.
Symbols alone aren't enough.

text.ko: 28년 동안 FSP가 한 것이 상징이에요. 분필 이름들. 이름 기록 요구.
text.en: What FSP did for twenty-eight years was symbols. Chalk names. Demanding name registration.
Symbols changed the world.
Yuna. You learned well.
The 72-hour countdown began.
FSP had to make a decision.
Would they launch Gaia.
Or accept Earth-side demands.

text.ko: 그리고 FSP 자체가 무엇이 될 것인가.
text.en: And what would FSP itself become.
The village was waiting.

prompt.ko: FSP. 이 마을. 이 사람들. 어떤 결말을 선택합니까.
prompt.en: FSP. This village. These people. Which ending do you choose.

text.ko: Gaia를 출항시킨다. 화성이 화성의 방식으로 존재한다.
text.en: Launch Gaia. Mars exists in its own way.
Negotiate with the Earth-side. Gaia can wait.
The player boards Gaia directly.

preview_hint.ko: → 엔딩: Gaia 선장 — 화성의 첫 항해
preview_hint.en: → Ending: Gaia Captain — Mars's first voyage

text.ko: FSP를 떠난다. 이름들은 기억하되 이 싸움은 끝낸다.
text.en: Leave FSP. Remember the names but end this fight.

subtitle.en: Hellas Mining Village — The Weight of 28 Years

text.en: The village was alive. The tea was warm.
Mikhail set down his cup. It was empty.

text.ko: 다 마신 잔. 28년 동안 끓여온 차. 오늘 다 마신 것이었다.
text.en: A cup completely drunk. Tea made for twenty-eight years. Today it was all drunk.

text.ko: Yuna가 새 잔을 들었다. 두 손으로.
text.en: Yuna picked up a new cup. With both hands.

text.ko: 오른손이 왼손을 받쳤다. Mikhail에게 배운 것이었다.
text.en: Right hand supporting the left. Learned from Mikhail.

text.ko: 이름들이 벽에 있었다. 이제 기록도 됐다.
text.en: The names were on the wall. Now they were also recorded.
The village was quiet. The tea had cooled.

text.ko: Mikhail의 잔이 여전히 가득 찼다. 마시지 못한 것이었다.
text.en: Mikhail's cup was still full. He couldn't drink it.
There was tea on Mars that couldn't be drunk.

text.ko: 식지 않는 차보다 슬픈 것이었다. 식어버린 차.
text.en: Sadder than tea that wouldn't cool. Tea that had gone cold.

text.ko: 그러나 이름들은 벽에 있었다. 그것은 지워지지 않았다.
text.en: But the names were on the wall. Those had not been erased.

text.ko: 분필은 약했다. 그러나 여전히 거기 있었다.
text.en: Chalk was weak. But it was still there.
Gaia launched.

text.ko: 화성에서 만든 첫 번째 함선. 화성 자체의 힘으로.
text.en: The first ship made on Mars. By Mars's own power.

text.ko: Olu Adeyemi가 지켜봤다. 편지를 손에 쥐고.
text.en: Olu Adeyemi watched. With the letter in hand.

text.ko: Mariam. 함선이 그 이름을 가지고 갔다.
text.en: Mariam. The ship carried that name.

text.ko: 헬라스 광부 마을로 돌아오는 길에 Mikhail이 말했다.
text.en: On the way back to the Hellas mining village Mikhail spoke.
'The names are recorded. What comes next Yuna decides.'
Yuna held the cup with both hands.

text.ko: 화성에서 태어난 첫 번째 세대. 화성을 이어받을 세대.
text.en: The first generation born on Mars. The generation to inherit Mars.
Gaia waited 72 more hours.
Negotiations with the Earth-side began.
Rev. Hale became a witness. Again.
Negotiations were slow. By Mars's time.
But names were being recorded. Even in between.
Mikhail made tea. While waiting.
Waiting was also a way. On Mars.
The player boarded Gaia.
Sat beside Olu. The ship's cockpit.

text.ko: Olu가 편지를 선반에 올렸다. 그것이 의식이었다.
text.en: Olu placed the letter on the shelf. It was a ritual.
The Martian sky was red. It grew distant below.

text.ko: 헬라스 광부 마을이 보였다. 점처럼. 그다음에 안 보였다.
text.en: The Hellas mining village was visible. Like a dot. Then it wasn't.

text.ko: 그러나 이름들은 여전히 그 점 위에 있었다.
text.en: But the names were still on that dot.
On the wall. In the registration system. In memory.
Names were not erased.
The player left the village.
Alone. Walking.
Mikhail watched from behind. Holding tea.
Didn't call out. That was Mikhail's way.

text.ko: Rev. Hale이 기도했다. 걸어가는 사람을 위해.
text.en: Rev. Hale prayed. For the one walking away.
The red dust road of Mars.
A person who remembered the names walked on.

text.ko: 기억이 있는 한. 이름들은 살아 있었다.
text.en: As long as there was memory. The names were alive.
